messages:
carol: heads-up: CI microbench flagged a regression in PR 21567 after merging the batch-slot reclamation tweak. p99 increased ~18% on x86-GPU run.
perf-bot: perf-ci: http://ci.internal/artefacts/1729000000/compare.html
ajay: saw the alert. initial glance: batcher now favors earlier slots which seems to increase KV churn for short sequences.
dani: @ajay can you share the CI diff? which metric flipped first (kv hit, p50, p99)?
ajay: kv_hitrate dropped from 87% -> 74% on the failing run. p50 flat, p99 up from 28ms -> 33ms. tokens/s down ~6%.
carol: thanks. suspect interaction with quantized concat path - commit 3f2d9b0 changed batch packing ordering. could cause more partial-KV lookups.
dani: reproducer run on my laptop (A100 emu) shows same hitrate delta. running flamegraphs now.
perf-bot: microbench logs: /artifacts/1729000000/pr-21567/logs.tar.gz
jen: if KV hit is main culprit, we need to know if eviction frequency increased or if access pattern changed. can we capture kv eviction count per epoch?
ajay: added quick probe: `kv.evictions_total` went from 120 -> 410 across same workload. that smells like fragmentation + more small batches.
dani: flamegraph snippet (trimmed):
```
runtime::batch_slot_acquire  40%
kernel_selector::score 12%
kv_cache::lookup_miss 18%
memory::alloc_fragmentation 10%
```
carol: interesting: kernel_selector time increased slightly, but kv_lookup_miss dominates. Could be ordering change triggers cache misses earlier, causing more allocations and eviction.
release-manager: is this a rollout blocker for the release? we have a staged rollout tomorrow.
jen: yes, it's a blocker for canary. p99 regressed beyond our threshold for the microbench gate.
ajay: plan: bisect between merge base and 3f2d9b0. I can run the bisect on CI. prefer to hold rollout until we narrow root cause.
carol: +1 hold. ajay, post suspected revert commit if found. we might be able to hotfix by reverting batch-slot heuristic or add a temporary KV hysteresis threshold.
dani: local bisect shows 3f2d9b0 is the first bad commit. confirming with a single-commit revert would be fastest.
ajay: ok creating revert PR now: `revert: batcher: relax slot reclamation heuristic (3f2d9b0)`
perf-bot: created shadow run for revert PR: http://ci.internal/artefacts/1729000105/revert-21567/compare.html
jen: if revert restores kv_hit to ~87 and p99 to baseline, then proceed with revert and re-run CI. otherwise we dig deeper.
perf-bot: revert run results: kv_hitrate 86.5%, p99 29ms, tokens/s within 1% of baseline.
carol: looks like revert fixes it. ajay publish revert PR and schedule a patch release. add postmortem notes about batch packing and KV frag.
ajay: done: PR 21610 opened. adding test that simulates short-seq-heavy workload to catch this.
jen: add unit that asserts kv.evictions_total < X on microbench to avoid future silent regressions.
carol: thanks everyone. follow-up: create a small benchmark harness for quantized concat + short sequences and add to CI goldens.
perf-bot: incident closed. rollback applied to canary. :white_check_mark:
release-manager: moving rollout back to green. will coordinate patch release.
carol: filing brief postmortem notes in #postmortems after we collect flamegraphs and allocation traces.
